item.title: Lenovo Brings Tianxi AI 4.5 to AI PCs, Letting Phones and Tablets Hand Off Tasks to a Desktop
item.description: Lenovo released Tianxi AI 4.5 for AI PCs, adding a Super Mode that acts across apps, an AI note-taker that joins brainstorms, and remote task handoff from phones and tablets to a PC.

item.title: Alibaba's Qoder Lets One Desktop Client Send Coding Tasks to Another Machine Without SSH
item.description: Alibaba's Qoder now lets users pair two desktop clients, start and follow tasks on a remote machine, add instructions and preview outputs locally, with no SSH or remote desktop setup.

item.title: Tencent Cloud Launches Data and Training Stack for Robots and Self-Driving, Plans TCLake XPhysis
item.description: Tencent Cloud launched an integrated multimodal data processing and model training stack for embodied AI and autonomous driving, and said it will release a TCLake XPhysis physical AI platform.

item.title: InSpatio Opens a Simulation-First Robot Data Center in Hangzhou, Targets a Million Hours a Month
item.description: Spatial intelligence firm InSpatio opened what it calls China's first simulation-led embodied AI data center in Hangzhou, aiming to produce a million hours of robot training data a month.

item.title: AgiBot Proposes Worken to Measure Robot Work, Aims to Cut Engineers per Robot to 1 in 10 by Year-End
item.description: AgiBot has proposed Worken, a unit for the useful work robots actually do. At one theme park it went from one engineer per robot to one per three, and targets one per 10 by year-end and 20 next year.
